  2. Gildan

    For 40 years, Gildan has been a trusted leader in the apparel industry, delivering high-quality and durability in every garment. From classic T-Shirts to soft hoodies, Gildan ensures that each piece is crafted with comfort, style and durability.

  3. What makes our products unique?

    At Gildan we source our cotton, spin yarn, knit dye and craft garments with care for the earth and its sustainability. Choose Gildan for fashion that feels good and does good.

Product Description

Made of versatile 100% cotton, yet constructed for durability with taped neck and shoulders, Gildan’s Toddler Heavy Cotton T-Shirt G5100P stands up to the wear and tear of the typical preschooler. This year-round wardrobe staple is perfect for everything from daycare or play dates. Decorate it with screen printing, embroidery, iron-on transfers and even bleaching and tie dye. The tearaway label is easy to remove depending on your needs.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    I give the Gildan Youth Toddler T-Shirt 2-Pack a definitive five-star rating. As a teacher, I rely on apparel that is reliable, consistent, and affordable, and Gildan delivers every time. This brand is my absolute go-to for durable, high-quality basics.

    I love to buy these shirts specifically to take to my local t-shirt print shop to create custom school spirit wear. The cotton takes the screen-printing or vinyl beautifully, ensuring our custom designs look professional and vibrant. Knowing I can get the same great fit and material consistency across all sizes (youth and toddler) is a huge advantage.

    Best of all, my own kids absolutely love matching me with their school spirit gear! These shirts hold up incredibly well to the rough-and-tumble lifestyle of a preschooler and a toddler. They wash well without losing their shape or vibrancy, and they don't develop holes after a few wearings. Getting a high-quality product that satisfies my need for affordable custom gear and makes my children happy is a total win.

    For quality, value, and reliability, especially for custom projects, these are unbeatable.

About this Item

  • Classic fit, side seamed body
  • Versatile mid-weight fabric for year-round wear
  • Taped neck and shoulders for comfort and durability
  • Non-topstitched, classic width, rib collar
  • Tear away label for customizable comfort
  • Suitable for screen printing, embroidery, iron-on transfers, bleaching and tie dyeing

Product Description

Made of versatile 100% cotton, yet constructed for durability with taped neck and shoulders, Gildan’s Toddler Heavy Cotton T-Shirt G5100P stands up to the wear and tear of the typical preschooler. This year-round wardrobe staple is perfect for everything from daycare to play dates. Decorate it with screen printing, embroidery, iron-on transfers and even bleaching and tie dye. The tearaway label is easy to remove depending on your needs.
